cases.text: In June 2025 I completed the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam. I also built a Flask web app with PostgreSQL that lets my university club manage 300 member registrations.
Our team won first place at the SDAIA Hackathon 2026 with an Arabic speech-to-text assistant. I trained the Whisper-based model in PyTorch and deployed it with FastAPI and Docker.
Promoted to Senior Data Analyst at Riyadh Retail Co. in 2024 after building Power BI dashboards that reduced weekly reporting time from 6 hours to 1 hour.

I have been working on some things with computers lately and learning a lot about different stuff.
Helped with a project at work this quarter, it went fine and people seemed happy.
Recipe: mix two cups of flour with one egg and a pinch of salt, bake at 180 degrees for 25 minutes.
The weather in Jeddah was very humid this week and the traffic on King Abdulaziz Road was heavy.
